title: Document that 1.34.0 was never published to npm
context: Version 1.34.0 was tagged in git but never shipped to npm; a release run stalled waiting for deployment approval that never arrived, and 1.35.0 shipped first instead. Users checking git history or the changelog could be confused about this orphaned version. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Added a note to CHANGELOG.md explaining 1.34.0 was tagged but never published, clarifying all its changes are in 1.35.0.
consequences: Reduces confusion for users reviewing version history
Documents why 1.34.0 does not exist on npm despite git tag existing
alternatives_rejected: Delete 1.34.0 section entirely (but it remains in git history, explanation is clearer)
Create separate file for skipped releases (less discoverable than inline changelog)
